title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-riley
content:
Daily triage scratchpad - quick notes, checks, and follow-ups. Rough and messy, for personal tracking.

2026-03-04 morning pass:
- Quick wins: restarted dashboard cache for 'Latency Overview' (cached widgets had stale series) - confirmed widget now shows correct 95p values.
- Still open: widget "P50 / P95 by model" missing when time range > 24h (observed nulls). Possibly query timeout or series cardinality explosion.

Priority items:
1) INC-2789 (ACME Corp) - customer reported high tail latency spikes during batch import around 02:00 UTC.
   - Symptoms: 95th latency jumps from ~120ms -> 420ms for ~7 minutes. Errors = 0, but high inference queuing seen on dedicated pool.
   - First check: confirmed spike on "inference.latency.p95{pool:dedicated,region:us-west}" dashboard metric.
   - Next steps: ping infra (Jordan) to verify GPU host saturation during the window. Also check autoscaler logs (RDW-3421 follow-up).
   - Notes: customer provided approximate timestamps 2026-03-02 01:58-02:05 UTC. I ran promql: rate(inference_queue_length[5m]) and saw ramp from 4->18.

2) Dashboard bug: "Model versions" gadget returns 500 intermittently when many model tags present.
   - Repro: toggle time range to >7d and click refresh -> 500 ~ 1/5 attempts. Local dev repro on staging. Suspect backend aggregation endpoint (models/versions/aggregate) times out.
   - Action: add a short-term fallback in UI to show top 50 models if aggregation fails (Samira volunteered to prototype).
   - Linked ticket: JIRA:OBS-2314 (assign to frontend, cc: eng-apis).

3) Alerts flapping: "Console:High-Error-Count" firing twice for same cluster across regions.
   - Hypothesis: alert rule uses union of pods across clusters without dedup; alerts created per region then dedup rule downstream not applied.
   - Temporary mitigation: increase firing window to 3m, add a dedup label. Real fix requires alert rule change in prometheus_rules.yaml.

Ad-hoc checks to run (commands / queries):
- PromQL: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, pool))
- ClickHouse: SELECT model, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) FROM inference_metrics WHERE ts >= yesterday() GROUP BY model ORDER BY quantile DESC LIMIT 50
- Kibana: search for "trace_id:" from ACME request 2026-03-02T02:00Z range, filter by host:gpu-usw-03

People to ping:
- Jordan Kim (infra) - autoscaler logs + host metrics (CPU/GPU/memory) for 2026-03-02 01:45-02:15 UTC.
- Samira Ortiz (frontend) - quick UI fallback for Model versions gadget.
- Priya (support) - ask ACME for exact request IDs if they have them.

Follow-ups / TODOs (tick when done):
- [ ] Collect GPU host metrics and link to INC-2789. (Riley / Jordan)
- [ ] Add fallback view for Model versions gadget and deploy to staging. (Samira)
- [ ] Increase alert firing window for Console:High-Error-Count as temporary mitigation. (Riley)
- [ ] Postmortem draft if ACME confirms SLA impact > 5 minutes. (Riley + PM)

Unresolved questions / notes to self:
- Why does the Model versions aggregation blow up on >24h range? Check if query groups by tag arrays; maybe expansion is O(n^2).
- Consider adding a cardinality cap or sampled aggregation on UI side.
- Need to validate that prefix/KV cache isn't causing stale series in "Latency Overview" when cache eviction happens at midnight.

Misc small notes:
- Sat down with Samira 2026-03-03 to review dashboard performance checklist. Add her checklist items to obs-runbook.
- Keep an eye on release tomorrow (2026-03-05) - UI changes might affect gadget endpoints. Coordinate with release-engineering for quick rollback plan.

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a proper ticket update after morning sync.
